FoulBreath.name: Foul Breath
FoulBreath.desc: A stench of rotten eggs wafts from the drinker's mouth. -1 SL to Fellowship tests for 1 day.

Cramps.name: Colic and Cramps
Cramps.desc: Painful abdominal cramps. -1 SL to all Willpower tests for 1 day.

Flatulence.name: Violent Flatulence
Flatulence.desc: Distracting affliction. The character may perform either Move OR Action in a round, not both.

Nausea.name: Nausea and Vomiting
Nausea.desc: Overcome with sickness. On failed movement tests, the character gains the Stunned condition.

Dizziness.name: Dizziness and Dark Spots
Dizziness.desc: Blurred vision and vertigo. -2 SL to Perception and Weapon Skill tests.

GutBurn.name: Gut Burn
GutBurn.desc: Violent acid reflux. The character immediately suffers 1d10 damage ignoring armour!

Poisoning.name: Toxic Poisoning
Poisoning.desc: Spoiled ingredients have turned to venom. The character gains the Poisoned condition.

Deadly.name: Deadly Poison!
Deadly.desc: Extremely lethal decoction. The character gains 2 Poisoned conditions and immediately tests Toughness (-20)!

Disasters.Ruined: Ruined Batch: A contaminated potion smelling of rotting sewage is produced.
Disasters.Smoke: Smoke and Stench: Heavy sulphurous smoke fills the area. For 3 days, the alchemist reeks of brimstone.
Disasters.Clumsy: Clumsy Accident: Apparatus is knocked over and shattered. Repairs cost 5% of laboratory value.
Disasters.Fumes: Acrid Fumes: The alchemist inhales caustic gas and must pass a Toughness (-10) test or gain Poisoned.
Disasters.AcidBurn: Acid Splash: Splashed with burning reagent! Suffers 1d10 damage ignoring armour.
Disasters.MinorBlast: Minor Blast!: Equipment damaged (10% value). The alchemist takes 1d10+2 damage.
Disasters.MajorBlast: Explosion!: Workshop heavily damaged (20% value). The alchemist takes 1d10+4 damage!
Disasters.Fire: Fire!: A raging chemical fire breaks out, destroying 30% of workshop equipment.

IronSkin.Name: Iron Skin
IronSkin.Desc: A draught hardened with Chamon essence, turning flesh to plate steel.
IronSkin.Effect: +2 AP on all locations and −10 Agility for 10 minutes.

LiquidGold.Name: Liquid Gold
LiquidGold.Desc: A sacred drink of the Gold Order filling the soul with pure Gold Weave.

QuicksilverSpeed.Name: Quicksilver Speed
QuicksilverSpeed.Desc: A concoction bestowing swiftness and mercurial reflexes.
QuicksilverSpeed.Effect: +20 I, +10 Ag and +1 Movement for 10 minutes.

LeadFortitude.Name: Lead Fortitude
LeadFortitude.Desc: A heavy leaden decoction steeling the mind against dread.
LeadFortitude.Effect: +10 WP and −10 I for 1 hour; +100 to Cool Tests against Fear and Terror.

ChamonPanacea.Name: Transmutational Panacea of Chamon
ChamonPanacea.Desc: A mystical panacea transmuting broken tissue into whole flesh.
ChamonPanacea.Effect: Instantly restores 2d10 wounds and removes Poisoned and Bleeding.

WeaveEssence.Name: Weave Essence
WeaveEssence.Desc: A decoction opening the wizard's mystical channels.

VitriolAcid.Name: Vitriol Acid
VitriolAcid.Desc: A corrosive mineral acid burning through armor and flesh.
VitriolAcid.Effect: Thrown like an Incendiary: every target hit gains 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions (acid burns). Blast 2.

LeonardPowder.Name: Alchemical Flash Powder
LeonardPowder.Desc: A powder causing a blinding flash and bang, disorienting enemies and disrupting spellcasting.
LeonardPowder.Effect: Blinds all within 3 yards (Blind condition for 1d10 rounds on failed Toughness test) and -20 to casting spells.

PhosphorFire.Name: Phosphor Fire
PhosphorFire.Desc: A pyrophoric incendiary liquid bursting into violent flame.
PhosphorFire.Effect: Incendiary: every target hit gains 1 + SL Ablaze Conditions. Blast 4: hits everyone within 4 yards of the target.

SmellingSalts.Name: Smelling Salts
SmellingSalts.Desc: A sharp ammoniac compound reviving the unconscious.
SmellingSalts.Effect: Instantly revives unconscious actors and removes 1 Stunned condition.

SmokePellet.Name: Smoke Pellet
SmokePellet.Desc: A smoke bomb creating a choking cloud of concealment.
SmokePellet.Effect: Thrown: a smoke cloud (4-yard radius) for 1d10 rounds where it lands, or at your feet without a target. Nobody can see into or through it, so ranged attacks and spells need a line of sight around it.

MorrSalve.Name: Morr's Salve
MorrSalve.Desc: A numbing analgesic ointment easing wound pain.
MorrSalve.Effect: Heals TB Wounds and removes 1 Bleeding Condition. One healing potion per encounter.

MandrakeExtract.Name: Mandrake Extract
MandrakeExtract.Desc: A heavy soporific and paralytic fluid.
MandrakeExtract.Effect: Challenging (+0) Endurance Test; on failure deep sleep after 2–3 hours, lasting 1d10+4 hours.

AntitoxinBroad.Name: Broad-Spectrum Antitoxin
AntitoxinBroad.Desc: An activated charcoal compound binding poisons in the stomach.
AntitoxinBroad.Effect: For 1 hour immune to Poisoned and poisons; does not cure poison already taken.

ClarityDrops.Name: Clarity Drops
ClarityDrops.Desc: Herbal drops clearing mental fog and sensory torpor.
ClarityDrops.Effect: +10 to Initiative and Perception for 2 hours. Removes Surprised.

DraughtOfPower.Name: Draught of Power
DraughtOfPower.Desc: A potent draught infused with pure aethyric power.
DraughtOfPower.Effect: Halves the CN of spells and rituals (minimum 1) for 2d10 rounds.

PotionOfInvisibility.Name: Potion of Invisibility
PotionOfInvisibility.Desc: Bends light around the drinker, rendering them completely invisible to mundane sight.
PotionOfInvisibility.Effect: Invisibility for 1d10 minutes. Attacks inflict Surprised condition, enemies without Second Sight suffer -3 SL.

PotionOfFlight.Name: Potion of Flight
PotionOfFlight.Desc: Invigorating draught infused with the essence of Azyr, lofting the drinker high into the sky.
PotionOfFlight.Effect: Grants the Flight (20) Creature Trait for 1d10 minutes.

ChannelpathPotion.Name: Channelpath Potion
ChannelpathPotion.Desc: Cleanses the aethyric conduits within a spellcaster, opening them to the currents of magic.
ChannelpathPotion.Effect: +2 SL to all Channelling Tests for 1d10 minutes.

PotionOfFortune.Name: Potion of Fortune
PotionOfFortune.Desc: Divinatory drops enabling the drinker to glimpse the tapestry of destiny and ward off ill fate.
PotionOfFortune.Effect: Restores 1 Fortune point or permits an Easy (+40) Augury Test.

NectarOfVitality.Name: Nectar of Vitality
NectarOfVitality.Desc: Life-giving elixir stimulating supernatural cellular healing and rapid muscle regeneration.
NectarOfVitality.Effect: Grants the Regenerate Creature Trait for 1d10 minutes.

Alkahest.Name: Alkahest (Universal Solvent)
Alkahest.Desc: The ultimate corrosive fluid dissolving stone, iron, and flesh.
Alkahest.Effect: Thrown: every target hit gains 2 + SL Ablaze Conditions (chemical burns). Eats through stone or steel. Blast 2.

CompassMeteoric.Name: Compass of Meteoric Silver
CompassMeteoric.Desc: Aethyric instrument that points directly to heavy magical concentrations, leyline nexuses, and artefacts.
CompassMeteoric.Effect: +2 SL to Navigation Tests when tracking sources of magic, storms of magic, and fulcrums.

LeonardoPowder.Name: Leonardo's Alchemical Powder
LeonardoPowder.Desc: An advanced explosive gunpowder igniting upon contact with air.
LeonardoPowder.Effect: Increases firearm/bomb Damage by +2 and grants Penetrating quality.

PotencyDraught.Name: Potency Draught
PotencyDraught.Desc: A concentrated bull root extract granting immense physical power.

LucidityTonic.Name: Lucidity Tonic
LucidityTonic.Desc: A potent stimulant banishing exhaustion and sluggishness.
LucidityTonic.Effect: +1 SL to all Intelligence- and Willpower-based Tests and no Fatigued Conditions for 3d10 hours; afterwards 3 Fatigued Conditions.

DebauchFriend.Name: Debauch's Friend
DebauchFriend.Desc: An indispensable companion for tavern frequenters — fends off intoxication and morning hangovers.
DebauchFriend.Effect: Automatically passes all Consume Alcohol Tests for 1d10 hours.

NectarOfBeauty.Name: Nectar of Beauty
NectarOfBeauty.Desc: Fades blemishes, smooths imperfections, and endows the drinker with alluring symmetry.
NectarOfBeauty.Effect: +10 to Fellowship (+1 SL) on tests with characters susceptible to the drinker's charm for 3d10 hours.

NectarOfVeracity.Name: Nectar of Veracity
NectarOfVeracity.Desc: Evokes an irresistible compulsion to utter nothing but the unvarnished truth.
NectarOfVeracity.Effect: Drinker must pass a Hard (-20) Cool Test to speak a deliberate falsehood for 3d10 hours.

HairTonic.Name: Hair Tonic
HairTonic.Desc: A cosmetic scalp tonic stimulating rapid hair and beard growth.
HairTonic.Effect: Causes rapid growth of luxurious hair or beard within 24 hours.

PanaceaUniversalis.Name: Panacea Universalis
PanaceaUniversalis.Desc: The legendary herbal panacea curing all natural poisons and diseases.
PanaceaUniversalis.Effect: Heals 3×TB Wounds, removes all Bleeding and Fatigued Conditions; Critical Wounds – Winds of Magic table (GM).

BoarsMusk.Name: Boar's Musk
BoarsMusk.Desc: A repulsive musk extract sickening opponents in melee.
BoarsMusk.Effect: −2 SL to Fellowship and Dexterity Tests and the Distracting Trait (affects everyone nearby) for 1d10 hours.

HealingDraughtCore.Name: Healing Draught
HealingDraughtCore.Desc: Standard medicinal brew concocted by certified apothecaries and battlefield surgeons.
HealingDraughtCore.Effect: Immediately restores a number of Wounds equal to Toughness Bonus (TB).

VitalityDraughtCore.Name: Vitality Draught
VitalityDraughtCore.Desc: Invigorating draught of restorative herbs and spirits that shakes off weariness and toil.

DigestiveTonicCore.Name: Digestive Tonic
DigestiveTonicCore.Desc: Bitter herbal tonic soothing gut rot, bellyache, and toxic indigestion.
DigestiveTonicCore.Effect: Clears Poisoned condition and grants +20 against gastrointestinal ailments.

Channelpath.Name: Channelpath Potion
Channelpath.Desc: A decoction easing the safe and focused flow of the Winds of Magic.
Channelpath.Effect: +2 SL to all successful Channelling tests for 10 minutes.

Flight.Name: Potion of Flight
Flight.Desc: A mystical nectar granting aerial levitation through force of will.

Fortune.Name: Potion of Fortune
Fortune.Desc: An extract of rare herbs bending the strands of fate.
Fortune.Effect: The drinker makes an Easy (+40) Augury Test (Intelligence without the Skill). On a success the GM reveals the likely course of events or the motives of a key character; on a failure the vision misleads.

Invisibility.Name: Potion of Invisibility
Invisibility.Desc: An extraordinary draft bending light and masking the drinker's presence.
Invisibility.Effect: Invisible for 1d10 minutes: mundane senses cannot see you (you can still be heard), Second Sight at −2 SL; targets you attack become Surprised.

NectarVitality.Name: Nectar of Vitality
NectarVitality.Desc: A rich golden draught stimulating rapid cell repair.
NectarVitality.Effect: The Regenerate Creature Trait for 1d10 minutes: at the start of each round the drinker regains 1d10 Wounds (at 0 Wounds, 1 Wound on 8+).

AqshyLiquidFire.Name: Liquid Flame of Aqshy
AqshyLiquidFire.Desc: A thrown phial containing the condensed heat of the Red Wind.
AqshyLiquidFire.Effect: Thrown like an Incendiary, but magical: every target hit gains 2 + SL Ablaze Conditions. Blast 4: hits everyone within 4 yards of the target.

AqshyBlazingHeart.Name: Draught of the Blazing Heart
AqshyBlazingHeart.Desc: A fiery potion boiling the drinker's blood with battle fury.
AqshyBlazingHeart.Effect: +10 WS, +10 S and the Frenzy Trait for 10 minutes.

AqshyWeaponOil.Name: Flaming Weapon Oil
AqshyWeaponOil.Desc: An ointment infused with Aqshy sulfur, igniting blades on impact.
AqshyWeaponOil.Effect: For 1 hour your melee weapons burn: every hit inflicts 1 Ablaze Condition.

AqshyWarBlood.Name: Aqshy War Blood
AqshyWarBlood.Desc: A searing draught eradicating fear and hesitation.
AqshyWarBlood.Effect: +20 I and +10 WP for 10 minutes; +100 to Cool Tests against Fear.

AzyrStarlight.Name: Starlight Phial
AzyrStarlight.Desc: A crystalline fluid illuminating sight with celestial blue light.
AzyrStarlight.Effect: Night Vision and Second Sight Talents for 1 hour.

AzyrAstromancerSight.Name: Astromancer's Draught
AzyrAstromancerSight.Desc: An astromancer brew giving glimpses of incoming blows.
AzyrAstromancerSight.Effect: +20 I, +10 Ag and cannot be Surprised for 10 minutes.

AzyrLightningReflex.Name: Lightning Reflex Draught
AzyrLightningReflex.Desc: A lightning-infused draught accelerating muscle response.

AzyrStormTonic.Name: Azyr Storm Tonic
AzyrStormTonic.Desc: A refreshing tonic shielding nerves against electrical shock.

MeteoricCompass.Name: Compass of Meteoric Silver
MeteoricCompass.Desc: A navigational tool pointing toward the nearest magical concentration.
MeteoricCompass.Effect: Detects magic within 8 km. Grants +2 SL to magical tracking tests.

PowerPrism.Name: Power Prism
PowerPrism.Desc: A faceted aethyric prism isolating and refracting the Winds of Magic.
PowerPrism.Effect: Allows filtering aethyr or altering wind availability (WoM p. 160).

GhyranSpringDew.Name: Dew of the Spring Bough
GhyranSpringDew.Desc: Sacred dew mending the most devastating trauma and amputation.
GhyranSpringDew.Effect: Heals 3×TB Wounds and removes all Bleeding Conditions. One healing potion per encounter.

GhyranVitalSap.Name: Vital Sap Draught
GhyranVitalSap.Desc: Ancient oak sap infusing the body with natural vigor.
GhyranVitalSap.Effect: +10 Toughness for 1 hour; in combat 1 Wound at the start of each round.

GhyranBloodPurifier.Name: Ghyran Cleansing Draught
GhyranBloodPurifier.Desc: An herbal infusion purging toxins and plagues from the bloodstream.

GhyranIronbarkSalve.Name: Balsam of Ironbark
GhyranIronbarkSalve.Desc: A salve endowing skin with the durability of iron oak bark.
GhyranIronbarkSalve.Effect: +1 AP on all locations (stacks with armour) for 1 hour.

GhurPredatorSight.Name: Predator's Draught
GhurPredatorSight.Desc: A concoction bestowing the heightened senses of a timber wolf.
GhurPredatorSight.Effect: Night Vision and Acute Sense (Smell) Talents for 1 hour.

GhurUrsineVigor.Name: Ursine Vigor
GhurUrsineVigor.Desc: A surge of primeval strength from a cave bear claw.

GhurPrimalRoar.Name: Primal Roar Tonic
GhurPrimalRoar.Desc: A tonic awakening savage instincts and predatory attacks.
GhurPrimalRoar.Effect: +10 WS and the Fear (1) Trait for 10 minutes.

GhurSavageSalve.Name: Savage Pheromone Salve
GhurSavageSalve.Desc: A pheromone grease pacifying wild beasts.
GhurSavageSalve.Effect: +10 to animal-related Tests (care, training, riding, charming) for 4 hours.

HyshRadiantPurity.Name: Elixir of Radiant Purity
HyshRadiantPurity.Desc: A sacred fluid cleansing corruption and dark blight from the soul.
HyshRadiantPurity.Effect: Removes 1 Corruption point – at most once per week per character.

HyshSunsWrath.Name: Phial of Sun's Wrath
HyshSunsWrath.Desc: A thrown phial bursting into radiant sunlight.
HyshSunsWrath.Effect: Thrown: every target hit gains 1 + SL Blinded Conditions unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test; Daemons and Undead suffer extra Damage at the GM's discretion. Blast 3.

HyshLucidityDraught.Name: Hysh Lucidity Draught
HyshLucidityDraught.Desc: A crystalline draught rendering the mind immune to shadows and deceit.

HyshTruthDrops.Name: Drops of Absolute Truth
HyshTruthDrops.Desc: Essence of truth discerning all deceit and falsehood.

ShyishPaleMask.Name: Draught of the Pale Mask
ShyishPaleMask.Desc: A draft halting pulse and breath into a state of suspended animation.
ShyishPaleMask.Effect: Feigned death for 1d10 hours: cannot gain or keep the Poisoned Condition; resists diseases and mind magic (GM adjudicates).

ShyishSpiritBane.Name: Grave Oil / Spirit Bane
ShyishSpiritBane.Desc: A weapon coating slaying incorporeal spirits and wraiths.
ShyishSpiritBane.Effect: For 1 hour your melee weapons count as magical and deal +3 Damage to Undead.

ShyishHourglass.Name: Hourglass Decoction
ShyishHourglass.Desc: A mystical fluid staying the final sand in the glass of death.
ShyishHourglass.Effect: For 1 hour: the first time damage would drop the drinker to 0 Wounds, they keep 1 Wound instead; then the draught is spent.

ShyishShroud.Name: Shyish Shroud
ShyishShroud.Desc: A brew wreathing the drinker in the dreadful chill of the grave.
ShyishShroud.Effect: +10 Willpower and the Fear (1) Trait for 1 hour.

UlguShadowMist.Name: Shadow Mist Draught
UlguShadowMist.Desc: A phial shattered on the ground creating a cloud of impenetrable shadow.
UlguShadowMist.Effect: Thrown: shadow fog (6-yard radius) for 1d10 rounds where it lands, or at your feet without a target. Nobody can see into or through it (total concealment).

UlguPhantasmagoria.Name: Phantasmagoria Elixir
UlguPhantasmagoria.Desc: An illusory draught shifting facial features, voice, and aura.
UlguPhantasmagoria.Effect: +20 to Charm and Entertain Tests (disguise, deceit) for 1d10 hours.

UlguStalkerOil.Name: Stalker's Oil
UlguStalkerOil.Desc: A silence grease muffling footsteps and armor clatter.

UlguWraithstep.Name: Wraithstep Draught
UlguWraithstep.Desc: A shadowy draught rendering the physical body semi-incorporeal.
UlguWraithstep.Effect: Allows passing through grates, doors, and bars for 1d10 rounds.

FlashPowder.Name: Alchemical Flash Powder
FlashPowder.Desc: An explosive pyrotechnic blend producing a brilliant flash of light.
FlashPowder.Effect: Thrown: everyone within 3 yards of the target gains 1 Blinded Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test.

QuickGlue.Name: Quick-Drying Glue
QuickGlue.Desc: A viscous resin adhesive curing in seconds.
QuickGlue.Effect: Instantly bonds stone, wood, and metal; can immobilize enemy boots.

DebauchsFriend.Name: Debauch's Friend
DebauchsFriend.Desc: An herbal decoction shielding liver and head from inebriation.
DebauchsFriend.Effect: Automatically pass Consume Alcohol Tests for 1d10 hours.

NectarBeauty.Name: Nectar of Beauty
NectarBeauty.Desc: A tonic smoothing the skin and bestowing captivating radiance.
NectarBeauty.Effect: +1 SL to Fellowship Tests against those attracted to the drinker, for 3d10 hours (toggle in the test dialog).

NectarVeracity.Name: Nectar of Veracity
NectarVeracity.Desc: A root extract preventing conscious falsehoods.
NectarVeracity.Effect: To lie, the drinker must pass a Hard (−20) Cool Test – for 3d10 hours (GM adjudicates).

Forgetfulness.Name: Draught of Forgetfulness
Forgetfulness.Desc: A concoction wiping recent memories from the drinker's mind.
Forgetfulness.Effect: Erases memories of the last 24 hours; a Difficult (−10) Cool Test resists it.

SoothingDraught.Name: Soothing Draught
SoothingDraught.Desc: A calming draught soothing agitated nerves and anger.
SoothingDraught.Effect: +10 Willpower, but −10 Agility, Initiative and Intelligence for 1d10×10 minutes.

HealingDraught.Name: Healing Draught
HealingDraught.Desc: A standard comfrey extract healing lacerations and wounds.
HealingDraught.Effect: Heals TB Wounds if the character has more than 0 Wounds. One dose per encounter.

MasterworkHealing.Name: Masterwork Healing Draught
MasterworkHealing.Desc: An expertly distilled restorative of exceptional mending power.
MasterworkHealing.Effect: Average (+20) Cool Test to swallow it; then 1 Fatigued Condition. Otherwise it does nothing – a placebo.

VitalityDraught.Name: Vitality Draught
VitalityDraught.Desc: A fresh sage draught expelling physical fatigue.

DigestiveTonic.Name: Digestive Tonic
DigestiveTonic.Desc: A peppermint distillate calming indigestion and sour stomach.
DigestiveTonic.Effect: +20 to recovery Tests against stomach ailments (e.g. the Bloody Flux) for 1 day.

MundanePanacea.Name: Mundane Panacea
MundanePanacea.Desc: A comprehensive herbal compound fighting wound infections.
MundanePanacea.Effect: Removes all Bleeding and Poisoned Conditions (does not heal Wounds).

SoulBalm.Name: Soul Balm
SoulBalm.Desc: An extraordinary salve calming traumatized spirits.
SoulBalm.Effect: +20 to Willpower Tests against Fear, Terror and Intimidation for 6 hours (toggle in the test dialog).

TrollrootTincture.Name: Trollroot Tincture
TrollrootTincture.Desc: A vigorous tincture drastically accelerating bone knitting.
TrollrootTincture.Effect: Doubles natural healing rate and halves fracture recovery time.

SkavenBrew.Name: Warpstone Draught
SkavenBrew.Desc: A vile Clan Moulder draught infused with raw warpstone.
SkavenBrew.Effect: +30 Strength and +30 Toughness for 2d10 − TB rounds; then a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test – on failure Poisoned and Bleeding (−6 SL: also Ablaze). Addictive: Hard (−20) Cool Test after each dose.

ReactionaryRestorative.Name: Reactionary Restorative
ReactionaryRestorative.Desc: A pungent, ginger draught stimulating the nervous system for swift defensive reactions and counterattacks.
ReactionaryRestorative.Effect: Cannot be Surprised for 1d10 hours; afterwards 1 Fatigued Condition.

FocusingPhiltre.Name: Focusing Philtre
FocusingPhiltre.Desc: A clear brew of Silver Lotus and crystalline water sharpening perception and analytical faculties.
FocusingPhiltre.Effect: +20 to Intelligence (not Casting) and Endurance Tests for 1d10 hours; afterwards 1 Fatigued Condition.

TonicSight.Name: Tonic of Sight Beyond Sight
TonicSight.Desc: A luminous elixir allowing one to perceive that which is concealed from mortal eyes.
TonicSight.Effect: A random Talent for 1d10 minutes (1d10): 1–2 Acute Sense (Sight), 3–4 Holy Visions, 5–6 Detect Magic, 7–8 Second Sight, 9–10 all of them.

CordeliaRestorative.Name: Cordelia's Enhanced Restorative Tonic
CordeliaRestorative.Desc: An exceptional alchemical tonic created by the brilliant physician Cordelia Welscher of Ubersreik.
CordeliaRestorative.Effect: Heals 2×TB Wounds; Difficult (−10) Endurance Test – on failure a side effect (Blinded, Broken, Stunned or Unconscious) for as many minutes as the SL of failure.

TrollAcid.Name: Troll Acid
TrollAcid.Desc: A corrosive secretion harvested from a troll stomach, dissolving metal and organic armour alike.
TrollAcid.Effect: Thrown: Damage +9 + SL (Penetrating, Dangerous); eats through up to 8 Enc of equipment.

VeinPowder.Name: Veinpowder
VeinPowder.Desc: Powdered toxic reagents from the Imperial Zoo causing limb numbness and paralysis.
VeinPowder.Effect: For 1 hour removes 1 Bleeding Condition at the end of each round.

QuicksilverMind.Effect: +1 SL to Intelligence-based Tests for 1 hour.
QuicksilverMind.Name: Quicksilver Mind Elixir
QuicksilverMind.Desc: A drop of purified quicksilver dissolved in a sage distillate. Gold Magisters drink it over tomes and crucibles – thought becomes swift and cool as liquid metal.

AqshyHearthfire.Name: Hearthfire Tonic
AqshyHearthfire.Desc: A warming red cordial that keeps the Wind of Fire glowing in the belly through the coldest night.
AqshyHearthfire.Effect: Removes 1 Fatigued Condition; +20 to Endurance Tests for 8 hours (meant for cold and exposure, GM decides).

AqshyFlameOfCourage.Name: Flame of Courage
AqshyFlameOfCourage.Desc: A searing shot that burns fear out of the heart and leaves only stubborn anger behind.
AqshyFlameOfCourage.Effect: Removes all Broken Conditions; +20 to Cool Tests for 1 hour.

AqshyFurnaceBlood.Name: Furnace Blood
AqshyFurnaceBlood.Desc: The drinker's veins run hot as a smithy's hearth; flames slide off the skin like water.
AqshyFurnaceBlood.Effect: +10 Strength and +10 Toughness for 10 minutes; the drinker cannot gain or keep the Ablaze Condition.

AzyrSkywardEye.Name: Skyward Eye
AzyrSkywardEye.Desc: Celestial magisters brew it for scouts and gunners: for a while the drinker sees the field as a hawk sees it from the clouds.
AzyrSkywardEye.Effect: +20 to Perception Tests (sight) and +10 Ballistic Skill for 1d10 × 10 minutes.

AzyrAugury.Name: Augur's Draught
AzyrAugury.Desc: Brewed under a clear sky; for an hour the drinker sees the small omens that precede every event.
AzyrAugury.Effect: +1 SL to Perception and Intuition Tests for 1 hour.

AzyrStarCompass.Name: Star Compass Draught
AzyrStarCompass.Desc: A cool, star-flecked liquid that lets the drinker feel the turning of the heavens even under cloud.
AzyrStarCompass.Effect: +20 to Navigation and Outdoor Survival Tests for 8 hours; the drinker always knows where north lies.

ChamonAssayersEye.Name: Assayer's Eye
ChamonAssayersEye.Desc: A drop of quicksilver tinged with Chamon: every metal and stone reveals its true nature to the drinker's eye and fingertips.
ChamonAssayersEye.Effect: +30 to Evaluate Tests for 1 hour; the drinker can tell true metal, gems and alloys from fakes by touch (GM).

ChamonLeadenWard.Name: Leaden Ward
ChamonLeadenWard.Desc: A heavy grey elixir; the skin takes on a dull metallic sheen and the mind a stubborn weight.
ChamonLeadenWard.Effect: +1 AP on all locations (stacks with armour) and +10 Willpower for 1 hour.

GhyranBloomBalm.Name: Bloom Balm
GhyranBloomBalm.Desc: A green salve that smells of spring rain; torn flesh knits like new bark over a wound.
GhyranBloomBalm.Effect: Heals 2 × Toughness Bonus Wounds and removes 1 Bleeding Condition. One healing potion per encounter.

GhyranGreenward.Name: Greenward Draught
GhyranGreenward.Desc: Life magic floods the blood and burns away any venom before it can take hold.
GhyranGreenward.Effect: For 1 hour the drinker cannot gain or keep the Poisoned Condition.

GhyranOaksPatience.Name: Oak's Patience
GhyranOaksPatience.Desc: The drinker grows slow and rooted as an old oak – and nearly as hard to fell.

GhurStagLeap.Name: Stag's Leap
GhurStagLeap.Desc: A musky brown draught; the drinker's legs remember the forest's wild running.
GhurStagLeap.Effect: +20 to Athletics, Climb and Swim Tests for 1 hour.

GhurBoarhide.Name: Boarhide Elixir
GhurBoarhide.Desc: Skin thickens into bristled hide and the drinker snorts like a cornered boar.
GhurBoarhide.Effect: +1 AP on all locations (stacks with armour) and +10 Toughness for 10 minutes.

GhurPackHowl.Name: Pack Howl Tonic
GhurPackHowl.Desc: Beasts recognise the drinker as one of their own – men recognise the beast.
GhurPackHowl.Effect: +20 to Intimidate and Charm Animal Tests for 2 hours.

HyshDawnlight.Name: Dawnlight Tonic
HyshDawnlight.Desc: A clear liquid holding a single mote of morning light; darkness and dazzle no longer bite.
HyshDawnlight.Effect: Removes all Blinded Conditions; for 1 hour the drinker cannot gain or keep the Blinded Condition.

HyshLanternEyes.Name: Lantern Eyes
HyshLanternEyes.Desc: The drinker's eyes glow softly; hidden things, false faces and illusions are laid bare.
HyshLanternEyes.Effect: +20 to Perception Tests for 1 hour; the GM may let the drinker see through mundane disguises and minor illusions.

HyshBanishingPhial.Name: Banishing Phial
HyshBanishingPhial.Desc: A thrown phial of concentrated Hysh that bursts in a flare of searing white.
HyshBanishingPhial.Effect: Thrown: every target hit takes 4 + SL damage ignoring armour and gains 1 Blinded Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test; Daemons and Undead may suffer more (GM).

ShyishMorrsQuiet.Name: Morr's Quiet
ShyishMorrsQuiet.Desc: A cold, still draught; blows and shocks slide off a mind already resting in Morr's silence.
ShyishMorrsQuiet.Effect: Removes all Stunned Conditions; for 10 minutes the drinker cannot gain or keep the Stunned Condition.

ShyishMementoMori.Name: Memento Mori
ShyishMementoMori.Desc: The Amethyst Order teaches that death is neither cruel nor terrible. For an hour the drinker truly believes it.
ShyishMementoMori.Effect: +10 Willpower for 1 hour; the drinker cannot gain or keep the Broken Condition.

ShyishSoulLantern.Name: Soul Lantern
ShyishSoulLantern.Desc: A pale glow kindles behind the drinker's eyes, steadying the soul against what lies beyond.
ShyishSoulLantern.Effect: +20 to Willpower-based Tests for 1 hour; the drinker can see spirits and ghosts (GM).

UlguThiefsFingers.Name: Shadow-Fingers Oil
UlguThiefsFingers.Desc: Grey Order agents rub it into their fingertips; hands blur at the edge of sight and locks seem to whisper their secrets. Outside the Order, owning it is proof enough of burglary.
UlguThiefsFingers.Effect: +20 to Sleight of Hand and Pick Lock Tests for 2 hours.

UlguShadowcloak.Name: Shadowcloak Draught
UlguShadowcloak.Desc: The drinker's outline frays into the grey mist of Ulgu; eyes slide past without noticing.
UlguShadowcloak.Effect: +30 to Stealth Tests and +10 Agility for 1d10 × 10 minutes.

UlguBewilderingDust.Name: Bewildering Dust
UlguBewilderingDust.Desc: A thrown pouch of grey glitter that scatters thoughts like startled crows.
UlguBewilderingDust.Effect: Thrown: everyone within 2 yards of the target gains 1 Stunned Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test.

AethyricSalts.Name: Aethyric Salts
AethyricSalts.Desc: Pungent crystals sniffed before a ritual, made by magisters of every College; the Winds feel a little closer and easier to grasp.

WardingDraught.Name: Warding Draught
WardingDraught.Desc: A bitter ward against hostile sorcery, issued by the Colleges to witch hunters and templars; the drinker's will hardens like tempered glass.
WardingDraught.Effect: +20 to Willpower-based Tests for 10 minutes (including resisting spells).

QuietmindElixir.Name: Quietmind Elixir
QuietmindElixir.Desc: A lavender-scented elixir that stills the stray thoughts that spoil incantations.

AethyricSteadiness.Name: Aethyric Steadiness
AethyricSteadiness.Desc: Brewed for battle-wizards: the Winds flow through the drinker without draining body and mind.
AethyricSteadiness.Effect: Removes all Fatigued Conditions; for 1 hour the drinker cannot gain or keep the Fatigued Condition.

WispPhial.Name: Will-o'-Wisp Phial
WispPhial.Desc: A Jade apprentice's trick sold to night travellers; the drinker shines with a pale green glow, lighting the way – and announcing themselves to everyone around.
WispPhial.Effect: For 1 hour the drinker sheds light in a 10-yard radius; −30 to Stealth Tests.

ThunderJar.Name: Thunder Jar
ThunderJar.Desc: A clay jar packed with powder and gravel; more noise than harm, but the noise is terrible.
ThunderJar.Effect: Thrown: every target hit takes 2 damage and gains 1 + SL Deafened Conditions unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test. Blast 3.

TarBomb.Name: Tar Bomb
TarBomb.Desc: A thin-walled pot of hot, sticky tar that glues limbs to limbs and boots to the floor.
TarBomb.Effect: Thrown: every target hit gains 1 + SL Entangled Conditions.

QuicklimePouch.Name: Quicklime Pouch
QuicklimePouch.Desc: A paper pouch of burnt lime – a cutpurse's weapon, cruel and effective.
QuicklimePouch.Effect: Thrown: every target hit gains 1 + SL Blinded Conditions unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Dodge Test. Blast 2.

Stinkpot.Name: Stinkpot
Stinkpot.Desc: A sealed pot of rotten sulphur and garlic mash, used to flush out cellars and break up crowds.
Stinkpot.Effect: Thrown: a reeking cloud (6-yard radius) for 1d10 rounds; anyone inside at the start of their turn must pass an Average (+20) Endurance Test or gain 1 Fatigued Condition.

Nightblack.Name: Nightblack
Nightblack.Desc: A greasy soot paste for face, hands and buckles; useless by day, invaluable by night.
Nightblack.Effect: +20 to Stealth Tests in darkness for 4 hours.

KeenEdgeOil.Name: Keen-Edge Oil
KeenEdgeOil.Desc: A grit-laden oil worked into a blade with a whetstone; the edge bites deeper for a while.
KeenEdgeOil.Effect: +10 to Melee Tests for 1 hour (the oiled weapon only).

SteadyhandDrops.Name: Steadyhand Drops
SteadyhandDrops.Desc: Bitter drops beloved of crossbowmen; the hand stops shaking, the tongue turns sour.
SteadyhandDrops.Effect: +10 Ballistic Skill and −5 Fellowship for 1 hour.

FireproofSalve.Name: Fireproof Salve
FireproofSalve.Desc: An alum and wax grease that Nuln gunners smear on sleeves and gloves; flames struggle to take hold.
FireproofSalve.Effect: For 1 hour the drinker loses 1 Ablaze Condition at the start of every round.

MinersPowder.Name: Miner's Blasting Charge
MinersPowder.Desc: A greased charge of blasting powder for splitting rock – and, regrettably, people. Most towns require a licence to carry one.
MinersPowder.Effect: Thrown: every target hit takes 6 + SL damage and is knocked Prone. Blast 5, like a Bomb.

GlowwormPhial.Name: Glowworm Phial
GlowwormPhial.Desc: A shaken phial glows a steady green for a whole night – a lamp that cannot set straw alight.
GlowwormPhial.Effect: When shaken, sheds dim light in a 6-yard radius for 8 hours (no flame).

EtchingAcid.Name: Etching Acid
EtchingAcid.Desc: A glass flask of engraver's acid; on skin it hisses and eats past any armour.
EtchingAcid.Effect: Thrown: every target hit takes 3 + SL damage ignoring armour.

ClimbersResin.Name: Climber's Resin
ClimbersResin.Desc: A tacky amber resin for palms and boot-soles that grips stone like a lizard's foot.

SneezingPowder.Name: Sneezing Powder
SneezingPowder.Desc: Ground mustard and lime in a twist of paper – a prankster's jest that has won more than one tavern brawl.
SneezingPowder.Effect: Thrown: everyone within 2 yards of the target gains 1 Stunned Condition unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test.

SympatheticInk.Name: Sympathetic Ink
SympatheticInk.Desc: An ink that dries invisible and darkens only when the paper is warmed over a candle.
SympatheticInk.Effect: Writing becomes invisible once dry and reappears when heated; spotting it requires a Hard (−20) Perception Test.

WillowbarkPowder.Name: Willowbark Powder
WillowbarkPowder.Desc: A bitter grey powder taken in water against aches, swelling and fever.
WillowbarkPowder.Effect: Removes 1 Fatigued Condition; on an empty stomach it gnaws – Easy (+40) Endurance Test or gain 1 Poisoned Condition.

YarrowPoultice.Name: Yarrow Poultice
YarrowPoultice.Desc: A packed wad of yarrow and wax that staunches even an ugly cut.

Feverbreaker.Name: Feverbreaker
Feverbreaker.Desc: A sweet-bitter syrup every apothecary keeps for the coughing season.
Feverbreaker.Effect: +20 to Endurance Tests for 1 day (meant for disease and fever, GM decides).

WakerootTea.Name: Wakeroot Tea
WakerootTea.Desc: Strong Arabyan kaveh with mint; it keeps a watchman awake all night – and very irritable.
WakerootTea.Effect: Removes 1 Fatigued Condition; the drinker can stay awake through the night without penalty, but has −10 Fellowship for 8 hours.

ChamomileCalmative.Name: Chamomile Calmative
ChamomileCalmative.Desc: A mild golden tea that takes the edge off terror – and off reflexes.
ChamomileCalmative.Effect: Removes 1 Broken Condition; −10 Initiative for 1 hour.

SteadyScalpel.Name: Steady Scalpel Tincture
SteadyScalpel.Desc: Surgeons take a spoonful before cutting: the hand steadies and the stomach stops turning.

ColtsfootSyrup.Name: Coltsfoot Syrup
ColtsfootSyrup.Desc: A thick brown syrup that loosens the chest and clears foul vapours from the lungs.

SlumberDrops.Name: Slumber Drops
SlumberDrops.Desc: Physicians buy it openly; poisoners buy it from the same shelf. A few drops in wine bring deep, dreamless sleep.
SlumberDrops.Effect: Hard (−20) Endurance Test: on a failure the drinker falls Unconscious and sleeps 1d10 hours; on a success gains 1 Fatigued Condition.

EyebrightWash.Name: Eyebright Wash
EyebrightWash.Desc: A cool rose-scented eyewash that clears smoke, grit and glare.
EyebrightWash.Effect: Removes all Blinded Conditions; +10 to Perception Tests for 1 hour.

BoneknitSalve.Name: Boneknit Salve
BoneknitSalve.Desc: A greasy comfrey ointment rubbed into bruises and cracked bones.
BoneknitSalve.Effect: Heals 1d10 Wounds; the salve burns like fire – Average (+20) Endurance Test or gain 1 Fatigued Condition. One healing potion per encounter.

GarlicTincture.Name: Garlic Tincture
GarlicTincture.Desc: Peasant medicine at its most honest: it works, and everyone knows you took it.
GarlicTincture.Effect: +1 SL to Endurance Tests for 8 hours; the smell is unmistakable (GM may apply −10 to Charm).

PoppyTincture.Name: Poppy Tincture
PoppyTincture.Desc: A physician's last resort against pain. Too many doses and the patient never wants to stop.
PoppyTincture.Effect: Removes up to 2 Fatigued Conditions; −10 Initiative and −10 Intelligence for 2 hours. Addictive: Challenging (+0) Cool Test after each dose.

MustardPlaster.Name: Mustard Plaster
MustardPlaster.Desc: A burning yellow poultice bound over the chest; it drives out the chill and stiffens the resolve.

CalmingOil.Name: Calming Oil
CalmingOil.Desc: A drop on each temple and the world slows down to a manageable pace.

WayfarersTea.Name: Wayfarer's Tea
WayfarersTea.Desc: A resinous trail tea that sharpens a traveller's sense of the land.
WayfarersTea.Effect: +20 to Outdoor Survival and Track Tests for 8 hours.

NettleWrap.Name: Nettle Wrap
NettleWrap.Desc: Stinging leaves bound tight over a cut – it hurts, and then it stops bleeding.
NettleWrap.Effect: Removes 1 Bleeding Condition; a dirty wrap festers – Easy (+40) Endurance Test or gain 1 Poisoned Condition.

MintBreath.Name: Mint Breath Leaves
MintBreath.Desc: Chewed before an audience or a courtship – a small advantage, but a pleasant one.
MintBreath.Effect: +10 to Charm and Gossip Tests for 2 hours.

WormwoodBitters.Name: Wormwood Bitters
WormwoodBitters.Desc: So bitter it brings tears; it purges the gut and leaves a face like a funeral.
WormwoodBitters.Effect: Removes 1 Poisoned Condition; −10 Fellowship for 1 hour.

ElderflowerSyrup.Name: Elderflower Syrup
ElderflowerSyrup.Desc: A fragrant cordial for travellers and convalescents.
ElderflowerSyrup.Effect: Removes 1 Fatigued Condition; +5 Toughness for 1 day.

JuniperSmudge.Name: Juniper Smudge
JuniperSmudge.Desc: Juniper and sage smouldered in a sickroom; the patient breathes the smoke and the air feels cleaner.
JuniperSmudge.Effect: +10 to Endurance Tests for 1 day (meant for disease, GM decides).

SunwortDraught.Name: Sunwort Draught
SunwortDraught.Desc: A red-gold tea that lifts black moods and keeps nightmares at bay.
SunwortDraught.Effect: Removes 1 Broken Condition; +10 Willpower for 4 hours.

MugwortDreamTea.Name: Mugwort Dream-Tea
MugwortDreamTea.Desc: Village wise-women brew it, and witch hunters call it witchcraft. The dreams are vivid, and the drinker wakes with uncanny hunches.
MugwortDreamTea.Effect: +10 to Intuition Tests for 8 hours after waking.

FoxgloveDrops.Name: Foxglove Drops
FoxgloveDrops.Desc: A heart stimulant measured drop by drop; a wise herbalist warns that the line between cure and poison is thin.
FoxgloveDrops.Effect: Hard (−20) Endurance Test: on a success removes all Unconscious and 1 Stunned Condition; on a failure the drinker gains 2 Poisoned Conditions.

HoneySalve.Name: Honey Salve
HoneySalve.Desc: Honey, wax and plantain – the oldest wound salve of the Reikland countryside.
HoneySalve.Effect: Heals 1d5 Wounds. One healing potion per encounter.

ThistleDraught.Name: Thistle Draught
ThistleDraught.Desc: Drunk before a feast to keep the liver – and the head – in working order.
ThistleDraught.Effect: +20 to Consume Alcohol Tests for 4 hours.

SleepwellTea.Name: Sleepwell Tea
SleepwellTea.Desc: Brewed at dusk; the drinker sleeps soundly and wakes rested even after a hard day.
SleepwellTea.Effect: Removes 1 Fatigued Condition; after a full night's sleep the GM may remove all Fatigued Conditions.

PlantainPoultice.Name: Plantain Snakebite Poultice
PlantainPoultice.Desc: Chewed plantain and forest herbs pressed onto a bite to draw out the venom.
PlantainPoultice.Effect: Average (+20) Endurance Test: on a success removes all Poisoned Conditions, otherwise removes 1.

ThornbarkRub.Name: Thornbark Rub
ThornbarkRub.Desc: A stinging rub that leaves the skin raw, stiff and surprisingly hard to bruise.

BloodrageDraught.Name: Bloodrage Draught
BloodrageDraught.Desc: Brewed from henbane in the hidden cellars of mercenary camps and banned in every province. It works. The heart pays for it.
BloodrageDraught.Effect: +20 Weapon Skill, +10 Strength and the Frenzy Trait for 10 minutes. Difficult (−10) Endurance Test or gain 2 Fatigued Conditions; addictive: Difficult (−10) Cool Test after each dose. Illegal.

Gravewine.Name: Gravewine
Gravewine.Desc: Dark wine steeped with moss from robbed coffins. Grave-robbing alone sends a brewer to the gallows; the priests of Morr would want a word first.
Gravewine.Effect: +20 Toughness and −20 Fellowship for 1 hour; cannot gain or keep the Fatigued Condition. Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain 1 Poisoned Condition. Addictive: Challenging (+0) Cool Test after each dose. Illegal.

BlackVial.Name: Black Vial
BlackVial.Desc: A thin black vial that shatters into a cloud of choking venom. Owning one is a hanging offence in most cities.
BlackVial.Effect: Thrown at one target: it gains 1 + SL Poisoned Conditions unless it passes a Challenging (+0) Endurance Test. Illegal.

WillbreakerDraught.Name: Willbreaker Draught
WillbreakerDraught.Desc: An interrogator's brew, slipped into wine. The drinker's resistance melts like wax.
WillbreakerDraught.Effect: −20 Willpower for 1 hour (the victim is far easier to question, charm or intimidate). Illegal – though some witch hunters carry it all the same.

WitchEyeDrops.Name: Witch-Eye Drops
WitchEyeDrops.Desc: A pinch of warpstone in the eyes tears open the veil between the drinker and the raw Winds – and lets in Dhar with them. Heresy: possession means the pyre.
WitchEyeDrops.Effect: +20 to Channelling Tests for 1 hour. Hard (−20) Endurance Test or gain 1 Corruption point. Addictive: Difficult (−10) Cool Test after each dose.

NightmareDust.Name: Nightmare Dust
NightmareDust.Desc: Henbane and bat wing ground to a grey powder; those who breathe it see their worst fears step out of the shadows. A weapon of thieves and cultists alike.
NightmareDust.Effect: Thrown: everyone within 2 yards of the target gains 1 + SL Broken Conditions unless they pass a Challenging (+0) Cool Test. Illegal.

TurncoatSalve.Name: Turncoat Salve
TurncoatSalve.Desc: Warpstone in wax: smeared on the face, it lets the flesh be kneaded like dough into another's likeness. The Changer of Ways smiles on every use. Heresy.
TurncoatSalve.Effect: +30 to Entertain and Charm Tests made to pass as someone else for 1d10 hours. Challenging (+0) Endurance Test or gain 1 Corruption point.

HollowHeart.Name: Hollow Heart Elixir
HollowHeart.Desc: A duellist's poison: the heart slows almost to stillness, fear and exhaustion fall away – and come back all at once. Banned, and rightly so.
HollowHeart.Effect: +20 Toughness for 10 minutes; cannot gain or keep Broken or Fatigued. When the elixir wears off, the drinker gains 2 Fatigued Conditions. Hard (−20) Endurance Test or gain 2 Poisoned Conditions. Illegal.

PlagueVapour.Name: Plague Vapour
PlagueVapour.Desc: A sealed clay egg of grave-rot miasma. The law hangs its brewers; witch hunters, suspecting the Plague Lord, burn them – usually with the house.
PlagueVapour.Effect: Thrown: a sickly cloud (6-yard radius) for 1d10 rounds; anyone inside at the start of their turn must pass a Difficult (−10) Endurance Test or contract a disease of the GM's choice (the chat card reminds the GM).

SoulburnTonic.Name: Soulburn Tonic
SoulburnTonic.Desc: Warpstone dissolved in henbane spirit: it burns a little of the soul as fuel, and the drinker feels unstoppable – for now. Heresy.
SoulburnTonic.Effect: Regains 1 Resolve point (not above Resilience) and gains 1 Corruption point. Addictive: Hard (−20) Cool Test after each dose.

IngredientsDesc.GoldIronFilings: Finely ground iron filings mixed with real gold flakes, used in Chamon transmutations.
IngredientsDesc.PurifiedQuicksilver: Multiple times distilled liquid quicksilver, the primary conduit for alchemical energy.
IngredientsDesc.GoldDust: Purest sifted yellow gold dust of highest grade from dwarven mountain holds.
IngredientsDesc.DragonAcid: Extremely corrosive, hissing fluid harvested from the digestive glands of a young dragon.
IngredientsDesc.QuicksilverCondensate: Concentrated quicksilver distillate suffused with sulphur vapours, rich in magical density.
IngredientsDesc.AlchemicalSalts: Purified alchemical salt crystals used to stabilize violent reactions in the crucible.
IngredientsDesc.LeadOxide: Heavy lead oxide powder, essential for binding and precipitating volatile essences.
IngredientsDesc.NulnWineSpirits: High-proof wine spirits from the distilleries of Nuln, a premier alchemical solvent.
IngredientsDesc.WhiteAlchemicalGold: Rare alchemical gold alloyed with silver, cornerstone of the Gold Order's master elixirs.
IngredientsDesc.SunDistilledWater: Pure dew collected at dawn and triple-distilled under focused sunlight.
IngredientsDesc.AmberGoldPowder: Crushed ancient amber from the Norscan coast blended with microscopic gold granules.
IngredientsDesc.EthericEssence: Volatile essence of the Aethyr trapped in a sealed phial, glowing with a golden aura.
IngredientsDesc.GreenVitriol: Greenish crystals of iron sulphate, indispensable for producing corrosive acids.
IngredientsDesc.SulphuricAcid: Dense, fuming sulphuric acid capable of dissolving most metals and organic fabrics.
IngredientsDesc.SaltpetreSulphur: Combustible blend of purified saltpetre and sulphur, foundation of alchemical fire.
IngredientsDesc.MagnesiumShavings: Shavings of metallic magnesium producing a blinding white flash when ignited.
IngredientsDesc.KeroseneRockOil: Refined kerosene and rock petroleum from Kislevite wells, highly flammable liquid.
IngredientsDesc.WhitePhosphorus: Dangerously pyrophoric substance that bursts into flames on contact with air.
IngredientsDesc.AmmoniumCarbonate: Smelling salts releasing pungent ammonia vapors to shock the senses awake.
IngredientsDesc.LavenderOil: Soothing, concentrated essential oil distilled from field lavender blossoms.
IngredientsDesc.YellowSulphur: Bright yellow brimstone powder from volcanic vents, vital for pyrotechnic concoctions.
IngredientsDesc.CharcoalDust: Fine oak charcoal dust, acting as a potent filter and binder.
IngredientsDesc.FreshMorrLeaves: Young leaves of Morr gathered at dusk in the shade of cemetery cypresses.
IngredientsDesc.OintmentBase: Purified animal fat blended with beeswax, creating an ideal vehicle for healing salves.
IngredientsDesc.MandrakeExtractIng: Potent narcotic and numbing tincture extracted from tuberous mandrake root.
IngredientsDesc.Mead: Traditional aged honey mead from the forest apiaries of Talabecland.
IngredientsDesc.SnakeweedCharcoal: Synergistic mix of snakeweed and activated charcoal that neutralizes toxins.
IngredientsDesc.ApothecarySpirits: Rectified medical alcohol utilized by certified apothecaries and herbalists.
IngredientsDesc.StJohnsWortMelissa: Dried blossoms of St. John's wort and lemon balm to ease nervous strain.
IngredientsDesc.MintDistillate: Cooling, invigorating essence of peppermint that sharpens mental focus.
IngredientsDesc.GriffinDown: Exceptionally buoyant, Azyr-charged down feather from a young juvenile griffin.

Settings.AddictionHint: Addictive potions (Poppy Tincture, Bloodrage Draught and some forbidden brews) call for a Cool Test after each dose, −10 for every dose of the same potion in the last 7 days. A failure brings Addiction: −10 to all Tests while craving (over a day without a dose), a Willpower Test every morning without a dose or 1 Fatigued Condition, and three good mornings in a row end it.
Settings.AutomateDisastersHint: On a fumbled brew the disaster takes effect: wounds from burns and blasts, an Endurance test against fumes (Poisoned on a failure) and, with the laboratory set by the GM, a blast or fire lowers the laboratory by one step.
Settings.QualityFromSLHint: 2–3 SL make a good potion (mundane: +1 dose), 4+ SL an excellent one (mundane: extra doses equal to the SL; magical: 1 tether point less per dose, at least 1).
Settings.ChamonBonusModeHint: How the Gold Order's affinity helps recipe memory.
Settings.ChamonBoth: +5 slots and free Chamon recipes (old rule)
Settings.ReserveOnStartHint: Starting a brew puts the ingredients into the cauldron at once and holds the tether points until the brew is finished. Cancelling (GM) returns the ingredients. When off, both are taken only at the brewing test.
Settings.LabByGMHint: Each character's laboratory (poor, standard, fine) is set by the GM in the workshop and used for every brew. When off, the player picks the laboratory for each brew.
Settings.WorkshopStyleHint: Workbench: the alchemy workshop looks like an alchemist's laboratory with a recipe book, a workbench and the tether chain. Classic: the previous look.
Settings.RequireDiscoveryHint: Requires the character to know the recipe from memory or possess a recipe book in inventory to brew it.
Settings.CopyNeedsInkHint: Copying a spell or a magical recipe into another book uses one Alchemical Ink per page.
